intro.heading: DIVYANSHU
intro.description: I am an engineering student at JIS University (Kolkata), full-stack developer, and open-source contributor. I focus on building scalable web architectures, privacy-first tools, and secure systems while serving as Chapter Operations Lead at OWASP JIS University Chapter and actively contributing to Elixpo.

fancySection.subtitle: Experience & Focus Areas
fancySection.content: My work bridges full-stack engineering, cybersecurity, and applied machine learning. As Chapter Operations Lead at OWASP JIS University, I focus on system integrity, client-side encryption, and privacy-respecting architectures. Whether building zero-knowledge password managers like Vault-me or browser-based deepfake detectors like Stober, I build software that solves real problems with uncompromising security.
highlights: Chapter Operations Lead @ OWASP JIS University
fancySection.contactNote: Always open to collaborating on high-impact open-source systems, developer tooling, and engineering opportunities.
fancySection.shoutoutText: for driving open-source collaboration and security culture.
